concerns.text: The specification requires 5 stochastic runs for each ablation configuration **plus** training of the main model, all to be completed within a 6‑hour wall‑clock limit on a free‑tier GitHub Actions runner (2 CPU cores, 7 GB RAM). Empirical evidence from prior QM9 GNN training indicates that a single 3‑layer MPNN on ≥10 k molecules typically exceeds several hours on CPU; multiplying by ≥10 full training runs will almost certainly breach the time budget, preventing the study from being executed and thus invalidating the ability to answer the research question.
